Sub Run()
' Run Funeral RunManager.SetFilter(AddressOf RowFilterFuneral) RunManager.Run(FuneralReportGrp, RunControlTbl)
' Run Annuity RunManager.SetFilter(AddressOf RowFilterAnnuity) RunManager.Run(AnnuityReportingGrp, RunControlTbl)
' Run Unit Linked RunManager.SetFilter(AddressOf RowFilterUnitLinked) RunManager.Run(UnitLinkedReportGrp, RunControlTbl)
' Run Life RunManager.SetFilter(AddressOf RowFilterLife) RunManager.Run(LifeReportGrp, RunControlTbl)
' Run Wp Endowments RunManager.SetFilter(AddressOf RowFilterWPEndow) RunManager.Run(WPEndowReportGrp, RunControlTbl)
' If IsMaster Then MsgBox("Runs completed.") End Sub
Private Function RowFilterFuneral(index As Integer) As Boolean Dim runType = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Run") Dim runModel = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Product") Return runType = "TRUE" And runModel = "Funeral" End Function
Private Function RowFilterAnnuity(index As Integer) As Boolean Dim runType = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Run") Dim runModel = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Product") Return runType = "TRUE" And runModel = "Annuity" End Function
Private Function RowFilterUnitLinked(index As Integer) As Boolean Dim runType = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Run") Dim runModel = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Product") Return runType = "TRUE" And runModel = "Unit Linked" End Function
Private Function RowFilterLife(index As Integer) As Boolean Dim runType = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Run") Dim runModel = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Product") Return runType = "TRUE" And runModel = "Life" End Function
Private Function RowFilterWPEndow(index As Integer) As Boolean Dim runType = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Run") Dim runModel = RunControlTbl.Value(index, "Product") Return runType = "TRUE" And runModel = "With Profit Endow" End Function
